data.why: Superdry recently opened its first store in Argentina, marking an expansion into a new international market. For an Interim CFO, retail store expansion creates immediate back-office operational strain around local supplier setup and invoice processing.
data.angle: Handling local supplier bills, multi-currency invoice keying, and manual AP processing across new international store locations.

not_chosen.reason: Bad news: co-founder convicted of rape in Cheltenham.
Recent debt refinancing is high-profile, but refinancing debt creates less direct everyday AP invoice processing pain than physical store expansion.
Hiring an AP Assistant is a clear operational signal, but citing a junior job posting is less compelling to an Interim CFO than store expansion into a new territory.
Bad news: departure of senior technology leadership to Burberry.
General store expansion plans in Europe are less specific and immediate than the confirmed store opening in Argentina.

data.subject: argentina store
data.body:
Hi Greg,

Saw Superdry opened its first Argentina store.

Setting up retail operations in a new country usually means dealing with dozens of new local suppliers, each billing in their own format and currency. Who on your finance team is matching and keying those in today?

Mindbody processes 95%+ of invoices end to end with Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
